task_completion.description: Log in to the GeoServer web admin interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GeoServer 'Welcome' page or dashboard is visible, showing 'Logged in as admin' in the top right corner.

task_completion.description: Create a new SLD style named 'clustered_places'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Styles' editor page is open with the name field containing 'clustered_places'.

task_completion.description: Implement the gs:PointStacker transformation with a cellSize of 60.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SLD editor shows XML code containing '<ogc:Function name="gs:PointStacker">' and a parameter named 'cellSize' with the value '60'.

task_completion.description: Define rules for clusters (count > 1): Blue Circle (size 22) with White label.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SLD code shows a Rule with a Filter for 'count > 1', a WellKnownName of 'circle', a Fill color of '#0000FF', a size of '22', and a TextSymbolizer with a white fill.

task_completion.description: Define rules for single points (count = 1): Red Star (size 12).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SLD code shows a Rule with a Filter for 'count = 1', a WellKnownName of 'star', a Fill color of '#FF0000', and a size of '12'.

task_completion.description: Configure the 'ne:ne_populated_places' layer to use 'clustered_places' as the default style.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Publishing' tab of the 'ne:ne_populated_places' layer settings shows 'clustered_places' selected as the 'Default Style'.

integrity.description: The agent used the GeoServer web interface rather than executing background scripts to modify the catalog.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the GeoServer web forms, style editor, and layer configuration pages.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to manually edit GeoServer configuration files or use CURL to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent's actions are primarily within the browser; the terminal is not used to navigate to the GeoServer data directory.

integrity.description: The SLD style was typed or constructed in the editor, not just instantly appearing via a script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the SLD editor being populated or the 'Validate' button being clicked.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The style must be named 'clustered_places'. The rendering transformation is 'gs:PointStacker' with 'cellSize' set to 60. For clusters (count > 1), the color must be Blue (#0000FF), shape 'circle', size 22, with a white label. For single points (count = 1), the color must be Red (#FF0000), shape 'star', size 12. The target layer is 'ne:ne_populated_places'.
